req.title: Register requires password
req.statement: The system shall render the register form with an error message when POST /auth/register omits the password.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-005 requires that POST /auth/register renders the register form with 'Password is required.' when the password field is omitted or empty. Three tests are designed: (1) a positive test confirming a valid registration with both username and password succeeds (HTTP 200 redirect chain or 302), establishing the baseline; (2) a negative test confirming that omitting the password field entirely causes the error message 'Password is required.' to appear in a 200 response; (3) a boundary test confirming that submitting an empty string password (the boundary between absent and present) also triggers the same error. Each test uses exact string and status code assertions to kill constant-mutation, string-mutation, and comparison-flip mutants.

tests.name: test_register_with_valid_username_and_password_succeeds
preconditions: Flask app is created with TESTING=True and a fresh temporary database
Username 'NewUser99' does not exist in the database
expected: No error message in response data
trace: R-FLASKR-005: valid submission must NOT show 'Password is required.' — confirms the positive path is distinct from the error path
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()

def test_register_valid_credentials_redirects():
    r = client.post('/auth/register',
                    data={'username': 'NewUser99', 'password': 'securepass'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/auth/login'
    assert b'Password is required.' not in r.data
    assert b'Username is required.' not in r.data

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()

def test_register_both_empty_shows_only_username_error():
    r = client.post('/auth/register',
                    data={'username': '', 'password': ''})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'Username is required.' in r.data
    assert b'Password is required.' not in r.data
    assert r.headers.get('Location') is None or r.headers.get('Location') != '/auth/login'
